summary.text: Douglas Michael Basler (known as Doug Basler) is the Republican nominee for Washington's 9th Congressional District. A Spokane native who has worked in marketing and as a volunteer youth pastor, corporate trainer and musician, he has run for the seat before and advanced from the August 2026 top-two primary with 24.1% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Basler was born in Spokane, Washington. Ballotpedia lists his career experience as marketing and work as a volunteer youth pastor, corporate trainer and musician, with affiliations including Street Church USA, the Salvation Army, Street Feed and the Rescue Mission.

A 2020 Mercer Island Reporter profile described him as president and founder of EZTVSpots.com, a graduate of Multnomah University, a volunteer church youth leader for more than 30 years, and a former senior vice chairman of the King County Republican Party. JNS describes him as a current vice president of the Eastside Republican Club.

Basler previously ran against Adam Smith for the 9th District seat. Ballotpedia lists him on the general-election ballot in 2014, 2016, 2020 and 2022, and KIRO 7 reported in 2022 that he had lost to Smith by wide margins each time.
He ran for King County Elections Director in 2023, receiving 15.9% of the vote against incumbent Julie Wise.
Basler advanced from the August 2026 top-two primary with 24.1% of the vote and will face Smith in November.
